title: Starter plan price increase
transcript:
[00:00] Victor: Proposal: raise the Starter plan from twelve to fifteen dollars a seat, from January.
[00:06] Amina: I don't agree. Starter is how most of our big accounts started. A price jump hits the funnel.
[00:14] Kai: Our costs per seat went up a lot this year, though. Starter is barely above break-even.
[00:21] Amina: Then cut the free storage on Starter instead of the price. Nobody shops on storage.
[00:28] Victor: That annoys existing customers more than a price change.
[00:32] Amina: We don't know that. We've never tested either.
[00:36] Kai: Could we test it on new signups only?
[00:40] Victor: Maybe. I don't think we're going to agree today.
[00:44] Amina: No. Let's revisit this next week with the cohort numbers.
[00:49] Kai: I'll pull the cohort numbers for Starter before then.
[00:53] Victor: OK. Nothing changes until we decide.
